# Orchard Provider

The Orchard Terraform provider is used to interact with an
[Orchard](https://github.com/openai/orchard) cluster controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    orchard = {
      source = "vladkanatov/orchard"
    }
  }
}

provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Orchard controller, e.g., http://localhost:8080
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Service account token for Orchard API authentication.
